english.note: This is the all-purpose term for an object used to hold or store things, including data in technical contexts.
Use this as the all-purpose noun for a container holding liquid or another substance.
Use 容器 when the holder is a container that holds contents rather than a stand or rack.

examples.english: This container can store a lot of data.
examples.traditional: 呢個容器可以儲存大量資料。
